Enter OpenMed/OpenMed-PII-Portuguese-BiomedBERTFull-Base-110M-v1-mlx, a 110-million-parameter model fine-tuned to spot and label PII in Portuguese clinical notes and medical records. sources.title: OpenMed / OpenMed-PII-Portuguese-BiomedBERT-Base-110M-v1-mlx
sources.snippet: This model is a small 110M-parameter BERT-style model that finds personally identifiable information (PII) such as names, medical record numbers and contact details inside Portuguese biomedical text. It labels words at token level so developers can automatically redact or mask sensitive data in clinical notes and research records.
